contract: A23-153: Codex[kind] = { Kills, Golden, Stage, First } for the 11 series-1 kinds (3 pages); the KillLog rule (MonsterKilled, not personal); stages at 1 / 100 / 1000 (Card / Silver / Gold Holo; bosses 1 / 10 / 30), a skipped stage paid in order; a minor share (info.Minor) counts but its stage reward is x MinorShare (0 without one); below XPCapBelowLevel the card XP is at most one level (A23-27); the first golden kill = Gold Foil (never a boss); rewards = 3 / 20 / 100 kills' worth (bosses 1 / 3 / 10, foil 5) of the kind's own XP / Gold as bank gold 'Codex' + XP; CodexUp { Event, Kind, Stage, Card, Gold, XP, Title, Page, Key, Args, Text } + a reward toast while ServerToast; a full page = its title once (silent at join); every card at stage 3 = CodexGlow; CodexCards = cards owned; snapshot Codex at join and on CodexOpen (1 s). Save v5: migrate fills the codex once from KillLog.ByKind (Golden 0, First 0, no reward); fillDefaults repairs it.
limitations: The card window, the 3D card and the evolve moment are 게임성 개발 1's (the contract doc); the card art is image gen 2's. The real DataStore round trip of a v4 -> v5 record is in tools/test_onboarding.py.
